title: Frozen Planet
description: David Attenborough's visually stunning nature series. The sun never sets over summer in the polar regions. See how hordes of animals exploit this brief window of plenty.

title: Frozen Planet
description: Witness how solar landscapes change as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some battle to breed and for a few it is a time of opportunity.

title: Frozen Planet
description: During winter most animals abandon the polar regions, but a few extreme survivors remain. This is the story of their battles to endure the planet's harshest winters.

title: Frozen Planet
description: The penultimate part of David Attenborough's acclaimed nature series. This episode looks at us humans, one of the polar regions' most ingenious inhabitants.

title: Great American Railroad Journeys
description: Michael Portillo begins his American odyssey in New York City, starting at Grand Central Terminal.

title: Great American Railroad Journeys
description: Michael Portillo heads east from Manhattan to Brooklyn, and takes the Long Island Railroad to Queens.

title: Great American Railroad Journeys
description: Michael Portillo follows America's iconic River Hudson, beginning at New York City's Penn Station, before sampling ale and meeting the State Senator in Albany.

title: Great American Railroad Journeys
description: Michael Portillo travels across New York state, discovering how General Electric also leads the way in rail technology.

title: Abandoned Engineering
description: The underground base with the power to destroy a nation, the site linked with an attempt to kill a dictator, and an ancient world discovered in the American wilderness.

title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
description: Michael Portillo heads from Southampton to the Isle of Wight, where he rides the island's railway, made up of recycled London Underground trains.

title: Secret Nazi Bases
description: Deep in the forests of East Prussia, a sprawling Nazi complex becomes the nerve centre of Hitler's empire - and the site of a daring plot against the Fuhrer.

title: Adolf Hitler's War
description: Adolf Hitler has his mind on making Germany into a great empire by expanding eastwards, but his invasion of Poland tips the world into a violent and bloody war.

title: Adolf Hitler's War
description: Betrayed, Stalin fights the German army in the Soviet states. The German occupation policies lead to the first extermination policies of 'undesirables'.

title: Adolf Hitler's War
description: As Hitler's troops advance, occupants in Ukraine, Belarus and Poland take the brunt of the occupying forces cruelty; and the first concentration camps are created.
